ZOOP: extract the authoritative OS ZIP to an on-disk runtime root

Authority discovery: confirm BOOT.md, boot_manifest.json, and BOOT_METABLOOMS.py exist at that root

Entrypoint execution: run BOOT_METABLOOMS.py (fail-close"
